note: The two sets are nearly identical in content, values, units, and quotes, both correctly capturing the drivetrain properties from the text and Table 5-1. The only differences are trivial: A labels the rotor claim 'Rated Rotor Speed' and adds an explicit 'fully-deployed' condition to the brake torque claim, while B encodes that condition in the attribute name. Both sets contain the same minor redundancy (brake torque stated twice) and both omit nothing important, so neither is meaningfully better.
